text:
UTA and MTL meet Thursday with both teams two days removed from games that said a lot about them. The Mammoth won 3-2 at TOR and have out-chanced every opponent in their last five, going 3-2-0, though they're without John Marino. The Canadiens had their five-game winning streak snapped when WPG came back from four goals down to win 5-4 in overtime. They're 4-0-1 in their last five but got only 48% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) in that stretch, and they're missing Ivan Demidov and Mike Matheson. Cole Caufield has taken Demidov's spot beside Slafkovský and Newhook.

UTA has taken 59% of the expected goals at five on five this season, MTL 52%. The Mammoth power play (0.79 expected goals a game) meets a Canadiens penalty kill that allows 0.85, and MTL takes 5.2 penalties a game. In net, projected starters Sebastian Cossa and Jakub Dobes both sit below expected, at -3.0 and -5.6 goals saved above expected. Dobes was at +17.3 last season. Our model has UTA at 3.51 expected goals tonight and MTL at 3.02.

Watch Logan Cooley (34% to score, 65% for a point, 12 points in his last 10 games) and Caufield (37% to score), whom Karine Hains of The Hockey News noted scored his 10th of the year. Nick Suzuki has been cleared from the injury report. Our under-the-radar pick is Anders Lee, a third-liner at about 14:19 a night who has 2.5 expected goals in his last 10 games. We have him at 23% to score.
